اقتدين (form VIII)
# اِقْتَدَيْنَ (iqtadayna) /iq.ta.daj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَدَى (iqtadā)
# اِقْتَدِينَ (iqtadīna) /iq.ta.diː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَدَى (iqtadā)
